critical_code_review_comments: stats_routes.py:68-74 — customer_debt_agg uses `$group:_id:$customer_id` then `$group:_id:null,count:$sum:1` which counts UNIQUE customers with debt (correct for 'X زبون مدين'). Good. customer_balance_agg counts customers with balance>0 (correct).

wallet_routes.py:202-214 — platform_purchase_debt aggregates supplier_orders status∈{pending,unpaid,credit}. Currently DB has no such rows so the field is always 0 — this is by design (graceful fallback) but means UI subtitle 'لا توجد ديون' will keep showing until a real unpaid platform purchase exists. Recommend documenting how a supplier_order becomes 'unpaid' (which endpoint creates it).

stats_routes.py:21-23 — Cache TTL is 60s with cache_key=f'stats:dashboard:{tenant_id}'. Good per-tenant isolation. POST /api/cache/clear was reachable (tested) and returned without breaking the next /api/stats call.
